title: Append pipeline_watermarks DDL to create_tables.sql
objective: Append the pipeline_watermarks DDL (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS + CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS, CHECK regex on last_ym) to etl4/infra/create_tables.sql per architecture.md section 3.
unblocks: T-17 (sink staged INSERT ON CONFLICT with watermark write in same txn)
T-21 (rewind primitive full implementation - DELETE FROM pipeline_watermarks)
T-22 (run_e2e pre-flight filesystem vs watermark drift check)

acceptance_criteria.statement: DDL appended cleanly; file ends with a trailing newline.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: git diff shows +21 lines appended after v_pareto_frontier view; od -c on last bytes shows ');\n' so trailing newline preserved.

Apply 1 exit code = 0 (first-time creation emits 'CREATE TABLE' and 'CREATE INDEX' for pipeline_watermarks and idx_watermarks_layer). Apply 2 exit code = 0 (emits NOTICE 'relation "pipeline_watermarks" already exists, skipping' and 'relation "idx_watermarks_layer" already exists, skipping').

acceptance_criteria.statement: \d pipeline_watermarks shows the architecture-spec columns + PK + CHECK + index.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Columns: layer text NOT NULL, table_name text NOT NULL, last_ym text NOT NULL, row_count bigint, updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(). PK: pipeline_watermarks_pkey btree (layer, table_name). Secondary index: idx_watermarks_layer btree (layer). CHECK: pipeline_watermarks_last_ym_check CHECK (last_ym ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$'::text).

acceptance_criteria.statement: Valid-ym INSERT succeeds; malformed INSERT fails with CHECK violation.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: ('vault','hub_flight','2022-07',100) -> INSERT 0 1. ('vault','xxx','2022-7',0) -> ERROR: new row for relation "pipeline_watermarks" violates check constraint "pipeline_watermarks_last_ym_check".

acceptance_criteria.statement: Row deleted at the end of the smoke (no residual test data).
acceptance_criteria.evidence: DELETE 1 followed by SELECT count(*) FROM pipeline_watermarks -> 0.

commands_run.cmd: Get-Content etl4/infra/create_tables.sql -Raw | docker exec -i etl4-postgres psql -U etl4 -d etl4 -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1
Get-Content etl4/infra/create_tables.sql -Raw | docker exec -i etl4-postgres psql -U etl4 -d etl4 -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1
commands_run.note: second apply (idempotent; NOTICE already-exists for pipeline_watermarks + idx_watermarks_layer)

commands_run.cmd: docker exec etl4-postgres psql -U etl4 -d etl4 -c "\d pipeline_watermarks"
docker exec -i etl4-postgres psql -U etl4 -d etl4 -c "INSERT INTO pipeline_watermarks ... VALUES ('vault','hub_flight','2022-07',100);"
docker exec -i etl4-postgres psql -U etl4 -d etl4 -c "INSERT INTO pipeline_watermarks ... VALUES ('vault','xxx','2022-7',0);"
commands_run.note: expected failure; CHECK constraint violated as designed

commands_run.cmd: docker exec -i etl4-postgres psql -U etl4 -d etl4 -c "DELETE FROM pipeline_watermarks WHERE layer='vault' AND table_name='hub_flight';"

integration_points.writes: public.pipeline_watermarks (new table in Postgres schema etl4)

notes: Architecture.md section 3 index specification is on (layer) alone, not (layer, table_name). The (layer, table_name) covering index is already provided automatically by the PRIMARY KEY btree. The idx_watermarks_layer btree(layer) is the only additional index, per section 3. Matches exactly.
